options: Measure Android (vmlab emulator) and macOS (vmlab VM) on this Mac first, while Windows finishes on the PC, then ship with SHIP=1 run.zsh --resume
Ship now and measure the devices afterwards
option_reasons: The owner's goal includes verifying performance on all three platforms. A device regression found before the ship goes into the loop as an amendment instead of a reworked pull request. The ship's gates run flutter tests on this Mac, which would load the CPU the emulator and VM measurements share, so measuring first keeps those numbers clean.
Shipping first would run the ship gates on this Mac during the emulator and VM measurements, and would open a pull request before the device criteria 10.12-10.14 have any evidence.
outcome: Green. Next is device verification. Android: vmlab android-phone, v-fix3.apk vs v-base2.apk, 5 opens, held, and 2 fresh-launch onboarding replays per build, using android_verify.py with quietready. macOS: vmlab macos-1, v-fix3.app vs v-base2.app, 3 opens and 2 onboarding replays per build, plus the sharpen check.
